lyrics:
[Intro: strutting guitar riff, steady drum loop, bass]

[Verse 1: falsetto lead, tight and rhythmic]
Collar up, chin out, eyes ahead
Got a coffee I can't afford and a plan instead
City's loud and the bus is late
But I've got a walk that says it's all going great

[Pre-Chorus: strings rise, three voices]
And it's alright, it's okay
I've been broke on a better day

[Chorus: three-part falsetto, strings, the riff underneath]
Head up, shoulders back
Walk like the rent's paid, walk like the rent's paid
Nobody needs to know what you lack
Walk like the rent's paid, rent's paid
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Walk like the rent's paid

[Verse 2: falsetto lead, a little grit]
Landlord's knocking and the fridge is bare
Got one good jacket and I wear it everywhere
Shop window says I look like a king
The till says different, but the till can't sing

[Pre-Chorus: strings rise, three voices]
And it's alright, it's okay
I've been broke on a better day

[Chorus: three-part falsetto, strings, the riff underneath]
Head up, shoulders back
Walk like the rent's paid, walk like the rent's paid
Nobody needs to know what you lack
Walk like the rent's paid, rent's paid
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Walk like the rent's paid

[Bridge: beat thins, voices lower, honest]
I've been down and I'll be down again
But not on this block
Not in front of them

[Final Chorus: everything, horns join, falsetto ad-libs]
Head up, shoulders back
Walk like the rent's paid, walk like the rent's paid
Nobody needs to know what you lack
Walk like the rent's paid, rent's paid
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Walk like the rent's paid

[Outro: guitar riff and drum loop, footsteps, fade]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 104 BPM, 4/4, F minor. A strutting, mid-tempo disco groove, exactly the pace of a confident walk. Cocky on top, tense underneath.

VOICE: Three men singing in a high, bright, slightly nasal falsetto with a fast vibrato, in tight three-part harmony throughout. The lead line is clipped and rhythmic in the verses. In the bridge they drop into natural, lower voices for three lines.

INSTRUMENTS: A scratchy, strutting rhythm guitar riff. A drum pattern that repeats identically like a loop, with a steady kick and a crisp snare. A prowling, syncopated bass. A string section with rising lines and stabs. Electric piano. A horn section in the final chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar riff, drums and bass. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:32 Pre-chorus. 0:41 Chorus 1. 1:08 Verse 2. 1:26 Pre-chorus. 1:35 Chorus 2. 2:02 Bridge, thinner, lower voices. 2:20 Final chorus with horns. 2:47 The chorus hook repeats with ad-libs. 3:20 Outro, riff and loop with footsteps, fading by 3:45.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1970s disco: tight, dry and glossy, the rhythm section locked like a machine, strings and voices bright on top.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The guitar riff and the walking beat in the first two seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The title says plainly what the original hid: this is about money, and the walk is armour. The bridge, 'not on this block, not in front of them', is a line a proud parent or grandparent might have said.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Bravado, honesty, bravado kept up.
